user.title: Select a PairLink switch
user.description: Select a visible switch to add.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Continue to register this switch with Home Assistant.

registration_retry.title: Registration was not completed
registration_retry.description: Make sure the switch is nearby, then submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Refresh {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Continue to capture fresh credentials for this switch.

progress.wait_for_registration: Press and hold registration button 2 on the target switch until the LED lights once, then release it.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the switch.
error.invalid_auth: The switch did not accept the captured credentials.
error.invalid_registration: The registration advertisement was incomplete or invalid.
error.registration_timeout: The registration advertisement was not received within two minutes.

abort.invalid_stored_configuration: The stored PairLink configuration is invalid.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured PairLink switches were found.
abort.not_connectable: This switch was only seen by a Bluetooth scanner that cannot make connections.
abort.not_supported: The Bluetooth advertisement is not a supported PairLink switch.

invalid_configuration.message: The stored PairLink configuration is invalid.

no_connectable_adapter.message: No connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy is available.
